note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). All four screens are portal screens in the lab tenant (DEV); the approvals are answered live by sam.demo and jordan.demo in their own browser profiles.
prepare: # owner signs in: browser profiles for labadmin (make.powerautomate.com, SharePoint), alex.demo, sam.demo and jordan.demo (Outlook on the web). Nothing is typed or stored here.

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1-2): site Purchasing, list Purchase Requests (Amount required, Justification, Status, DecisionBy, DecisionComments); solution Purchase Approvals (PurchaseApprovals) with the flow 'Purchase request approval' built from src/solution

# owner (Entra and Microsoft 365, set up here and undone in teardown): Sam Demo set as Manager of Alex Demo; riley.demo without a manager; Microsoft 365 groups purchasing-team (member taylor.demo) and finance-approvers (member jordan.demo). Episodes 3 and 4 reuse them.

# owner (demo.md Setup 4-6): as alex.demo create USB-C cables 120, Ergonomic chairs for the support team 1,800 and Laptops for two new developers 12,500; answer the 1,800 as sam.demo and the 12,500 as sam.demo then jordan.demo; save the lab copy of the flow with the manager timeout PT5M and leave one request unanswered for five minutes

screens.name: list
steps: Open the Purchasing site and the list 'Purchase Requests'
Show the columns Title, Amount (EUR), Justification, Status, Decision by, Decision comments and Created by
Point at USB-C cables 120 (Approved, 'Policy: under 500 EUR'), Ergonomic chairs 1,800 and Laptops for two new developers 12,500 (Pending)
mask: tenant name in the address bar and the SharePoint header
any e-mail address that is not a lab user

screens.name: approval-outlook
steps: In the browser profile of Sam Demo open the inbox
Open the actionable message 'Manager approval: Laptops for two new developers (12500 EUR)'
Scroll through the requester, amount, justification (markdown) and the item link
Show the Approve and Reject buttons and click into the comment box without sending
Alternative: show the same request in the Teams Approvals app
mask: real tenant domain and e-mail addresses
tenant name in the suite bar

screens.name: run-sequential
steps: Open the flow 'Purchase request approval' and its run history
Open the run for the 12,500 EUR request after both approvals
Show Manager approval and Finance approval green, Record finance response green and Record finance timeout skipped (grey)
Show Finance result green and the Route decision switch on the Approve branch
Show Mark approved and Notify requester approved green
mask: environment ID in the address bar
approval IDs in the action outputs

screens.name: escalated
steps: Open the run history of the lab copy of the flow (manager timeout PT5M)
Open the run of the unanswered request
Show Manager approval orange (timed out) and Record manager timeout green
Show Route decision on the TimedOut branch, Mark escalated and Notify purchasing team green
Second capture, same scene: open the high-importance escalation mail in the purchasing mailbox (taylor.demo, member of purchasing-team)
mask: environment ID in the address bar

teardown: # owner (tenant): restore the P3D timeouts or delete the PT5M lab copy; turn the flow off; cancel pending approvals in Approvals > Sent; delete the sample requests if the list is not reused
# owner (Entra): clear Alex Demo's manager unless episode 4 is recorded next; delete the groups purchasing-team and finance-approvers only after episodes 3 and 4
